# 1,000.00 US dollars bought at 1.30, and 400.00 of them moved to a savings
# account in a transaction stated in Canadian dollars, each side valued at the
# 1.30 they cost.
#
# The move is a transfer: the book held the 400.00 before and holds them after,
# so the savings split is no cost basis. An earlier release read it as an
# arrival at 1.30 and stored a cost basis balance on it.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_a_transfer_an_earlier_release_gave_a_balance_is_reported.py.
2039-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2039-01-01 commodity USD
	mnemonic: "USD"
	fullname: "US Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2039-01-01 open Assets
	type: "Asset"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2039-01-01 open Assets:CAD Bank
	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2039-01-01 open Assets:USD Bank
	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2039-01-01 open Assets:USD Savings
	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2039-01-01 open Equity
	type: "Equity"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2039-01-01 open Equity:Opening
	type: "Equity"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

2039-01-02 * "Opening capital"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:CAD Bank 5000.00 CAD
	Equity:Opening -5000.00 CAD

2039-01-05 * "Buy 1,000.00 USD at 1.30"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:USD Bank 1000.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "13/10"
		value: "1300.00"
	Assets:CAD Bank -1300.00 CAD

2039-02-01 * "Move 400.00 USD to savings"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:USD Bank -400.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "13/10"
		value: "-520.00"
	Assets:USD Savings 400.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "13/10"
		value: "520.00"
